title: Jar intent rules (fixture)
summary: Observed business rules separating real accounting from virtual jar intent.

sources.notes: Accounting Consistency Review + Current Jar Logic

observations: Real balances are calculated entirely from accounts and transactions.
Virtual balances are calculated entirely from jar_movements.
Jar types include essential, investment, play with spend policies flexible or invest_only.
open_questions: Do monthly_budgets still gate spending or are they reporting-only?

rules.statement: Jars MUST NOT hold real money; only virtual balances.
Jar movements for expenses SHOULD originate from resolved review queue items.
